_comment: Thematic-cluster manifest for tools/generate.py. Claude plugin source lives under plugins/elian-store; Codex shared skills point there by symlink, while prompt-only adapters remain independent. Skill counts are discovered dynamically.

elian-dev.description: The workflow that needs a code repository: approval-gated TDD implementation, root-cause bug fixing, evidence-backed improvement, findings-first engineering review, persona-lens review, multi-perspective PR review, PR/MR description drafting, the consumer side of receiving review feedback, verify-skill discovery and drift repair, a claim-time evidence gate, requirement-to-test coverage tracking, and harness reconciliation.

elian-common.description: The workflow that works outside a code repository: requirements intake, gated design-document generation, design-change propagation, decision dashboards, schema-validated document rendering, self-contained house-styled documents, schema lineage previews, execution routing across subagents and teams, and structured brainstorming.

codex._comment: Codex distribution per skill. claude_only = blocked by a real runtime limitation; prompt_only = hand-authored Codex prompt; deferred = portable but intentionally not shipped yet; everything else ships as a codex/skills/<name> symlink.
